sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and the feature it bears
sets.explanation: Every cane bears its thorn and every bloom its petal — the whole always carries that part.

sets.relationshipLabel: a rose class and its famous named cultivar
sets.explanation: Peace is the hybrid tea everyone names, and Iceberg is the floribunda everyone names — a class giving rise to its signature member.

sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the thing their work is about
sets.explanation: A florist's work is the bouquet, a breeder's work is the cultivar — each worker defined by the object their labor produces.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across a span
sets.explanation: Planting and uprooting are the opening and closing acts of a rose's life, just as budding and wilting bracket its bloom — start and end of the same arc, not simple opposites.
